assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full bleed landscape website hero photograph for an original upscale restaurant with a Soulslike epic atmosphere. Like a real Michelin-level restaurant carefully placed inside a medieval abbey, beautiful calm sanctuary after a long journey. Extremely sophisticated natural photography, visible tactile limestone, 35mm architectural lens, subtle atmospheric haze, rich detail, realistic indirect light, deep but readable blacks, amber candles against cool stone, no strong orange cast. Wide 3:2 landscape framing, lower left quadrant dark and visually quiet for large title overlay; architectural focal point in center/right; perspective feels monumental, generous negative space.
